title: Nonplanar tertiary-N extended nitrobenzene enables insoluble and low-energy-barrier organic small-molecule cathodes for high-performance aqueous batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02250B, Paper

Ziyang Song, Qi Huang, Yaokang Lv, Lihua Gan, Mingxian Liu
A nonplanar tertiary-N extended nitrobenzene enables an insoluble and low-energy-barrier nitroarene small molecule cathode, achieving a state-of-the-art cycling life of 180 000 cycles in aqueous batteries.
